additional_info.subject: R: 0406871 - ID0406871-DC/Si-D/IT-[Multi] Iplanet unable to charge with 2 different debit cards CRM:02023000512
additional_info.body:
Dear Beerpal,
as already mentioned, the connection situation is like to follow:
Charger is connected OCPP to the backend;
POS is connected OCPI to the payment system, so we don’t have any integrated payment system in the charger.
The charger receives via OCPP from the back-end the charging authorization only if the payment system agreed to do that.
Whenever the payment system doesn’t receive any credit card authorization the charger would not start to charge.
BR
Luca

additional_info.subject: RE: 0406871 - ID0406871-DC/Si-D/IT-[Multi] Iplanet unable to charge with 2 different debit cards CRM:02023000512
additional_info.body:
Hello Luigi,
Thaks for the response.
As we checked the logs for the given timestamp, below are our observations:
1.
CU 170002725→
As we can see from the logs, the remote authorization was done at 16:41:31hrs. Until 16:43 hrs, no cable was connected to the EV. After that, the connector became available again at 2025-02-16T16:43:21 so the session was not completed.
2. CU
170002562-
In this case as we can see, the authorization was not completed because the 'IdTag': '02347CE8862000' was not authorized at 17:46hrs due to the Id tag is not whitelisted.
Id Tags are
to be whitelisted by CPO's Backend.
Also, I checked the logs for one hour prior on the same day, where a similar pattern is shown. At that time, the idTag: 'A626EB8D' was also not whitelisted, and the authorization failed.
If this answers your queries, shall we proceed and close this ticket?
Regards,
Beerpal
Singh
eMobility Support
